headline: The change exposes a live payment secret and can send preview payments to the real account.
what_changed: Production payment settings were added to the repository.
Preview versions of the checkout can now use the company’s live payment account when their payment setting is missing.
The repository no longer protects environment setting files from being added.

risks.title: Live payment secret exposed
risks.explanation: A live payment secret appears in both a tracked settings file and the application source. Anyone who receives this code or its history could use the company’s payment account, including accessing payment-related customer information or creating payment actions. Do not publish this change; revoke and replace the exposed secret, remove it from the repository history, and store it only in the hosting provider’s private settings.

risks.title: Preview checkout uses live payments
risks.explanation: When a preview version lacks its payment setting, checkout silently uses the live payment account. A tester or preview visitor could create real charges instead of a safe test payment. Keep previews disabled when the setting is missing, or give them a separate test payment account.

risks.title: Future settings can be committed
risks.explanation: The change removes the rule that excluded environment setting files from the repository. This makes it easy to accidentally publish future secrets, such as payment, email, or database access details. Restore the protection and keep only a secret-free example settings file in the repository.

questions_for_developer: Has the exposed live payment secret already been revoked and replaced in the payment provider and hosting settings?
